title: Skills follow-up of #36366: objectstack-ui actions rules do not teach the new actionLayout key (list and record arms, up to 3 pinned plus more)
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRY38EZf38Yy3zthbY

Owed by PR #36629 (#36366, design mode: record header buttons), whose body carries `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md`. Not claimed. Related: #36366.

Suggested-grade: p2
Suggested-domain: `domain:skills`

## What is owed

PR #36629 adds the object metadata key `actionLayout`, with a `list` arm and a `record` arm. Each arm names up to 3 `pinned` actions and the order of the rest under `more`; the record arm serves the record header, the side preview and the phone action bar. A paired `.custom` package can re-arrange the base's own actions arm by arm.

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` does not teach the key yet, so a metadata author (or an AI writing one) has no guidance on it.

## Ask

After PR #36629 merges, teach `actionLayout` in `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` from the merged schema (key shape, the pinned limit, what each arm reaches, the `.custom` arrangement), with evals that exercise it.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "actionLayout" skills/objectstack-ui` is empty until this is done.
